Some botanical ingredients may affect blood glucose and could increase the risk of low blood sugar when combined with diabetes medication.

Do not stop, reduce, or replace prescribed medication because of supplement claims. Follow your healthcare professional's advice regarding blood glucose monitoring, diet, and treatment.
